explication: winapp CLI is a Windows app development toolkit for cross-platform projects, covering SDK/API setup, package identity, manifests, certificates, and MSIX packaging. The primary workflow is a developer invoking the CLI to prepare a project and produce a Windows-ready package. The map also includes API and control search, UI automation, DevTools, analyzers, and the npm JS-bindings integration. Several command areas are documented in the README but their implementations were not sampled; those links are documented capability relationships, not inspected call chains.
